name: Jammu and Kashmir State Data Centre, Civil Secretariat Jammu
developer: Jammu and Kashmir Information Technology Department / JaKeGA / C-DAC
notes: State Data Centre for J&K government applications; SLBC/IT-sector material says the SDC was commissioned in March 2013 under NeGP, while June 2022 reporting says the modernized Civil Secretariat Jammu facility was inaugurated and is managed by C-DAC with J&K IT Department support. Capacity not disclosed.

name: IIT Jammu Data Center and Operations Management / Agastya HPC
notes: Official IIT Jammu Digital Infrastructure page describes a centralized data center supporting research, learning and enterprise services, including Agastya HPC with 82 nodes and 256 TF compute, big-data and private-cloud clusters. Institutional/research facility; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: SKUAST-Jammu NKN Lab and Data Centre
developer: Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Jammu
notes: Official SKUAST-Jammu page lists the NKN Lab and Data Centre at Main Campus Chatha, supporting university IT services, secure networks, web services, email, library access and related academic/research connectivity. Campus facility; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: J&K Data Centre / Data Recovery Centre networking and security modernization
developer: Jammu and Kashmir e-Governance Agency / Information Technology Department
notes: Official J&K eProcurement listing found for supply, installation, migration, testing and commissioning of networking/security equipment for the Data Centre and Data Recovery Centre established at Srinagar and Jammu respectively; tender value shown as INR 9.5 crore. Treat as infrastructure modernization rather than a new MW-scale data center.
